# PageNumberOf

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders the page number on which a named `Section` (or anchored `Heading`) sits - the "see page 42" cross-reference. The number is resolved from the shared `TocEntries` registry, which is seeded by the two-pass layout (a document containing a `PageNumberOf` is laid out twice; see `TocLayout.RequiresTwoPass`).

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `TextBlock`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new PageNumberOf(string anchorTarget)
```

## Properties

- [`AnchorTarget`](#anchortarget): The anchor id whose page number is printed.
- [`CaptureType`](#capturetype): Stable node name for the layout snapshot tree.
- [`Placeholder`](#placeholder): Text shown before the page is resolved (dry-run pass) or when the anchor id is unknown.

Text shown before the page is resolved (dry-run pass) or when the anchor id is unknown. Kept short and stable so it does not disturb pagination.
